title: Map and analyse the growth funnel
summary: Map how people discover, try, adopt, pay for and recommend your product, and find where most are lost.

beginner: List the stages: discover, sign up, first value, regular use, pay, recommend.
Measure how many people reach each stage.
Split by channel and user type.
Pick the stage where improvement would matter most.
intermediate: Map and measure the full funnel.
experienced: Model growth loops, not just the funnel.
Link funnel stages to unit economics.

toolExamples.amplitude: Build a funnel from sign-up to first value and break it down by channel.
toolExamples.mixpanel: Use funnels and cohorts to find drop-offs.
toolExamples.ga4: Use a funnel exploration for acquisition stages.
